name: Sharepoint share link
description: A text filter for embedding SharePoint share links, with SharePoint file download integration.
project_description:
A filter one can use to replace URLs that seem like sharepoint share URLs, and then instead replace them with URLs to download from sharepoint using the sharepoint_file_download module.

 Features 
 Configure a text format to change links to be accessible with an integration download instead.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires the sharepoint_file_download module.
